name: OPEN!!! Bee Swarm Simulator Sandbox!
desc:
Welcome to Bee Swarm Sandbox!

🍯 you make lots and lots of honey here, so this isnt unbalanced! (you make e+ in this game!)

🐝 We have many many bees in the game, I recently added 20 new bees!

🌟 TEST REALM BUTTONS!!

🥇 Leaderboards here are very very competitive, you can get decillions of honey!

🧩 custom + fan-made stuff can get added here (you can suggest us some stuff to add too!)

🌌 there are extra zones like 40, 45, 50, 55 and 60 Bee zones.

💎 Join OODI STUDIOS to get notified about updates, codes, fixes and more!

🌟 Custom amulets (after SSA)

Enjoy!
